name: T.O.T.S.
description: A heartfelt animated comedy series for preschoolers exploring the hilarious adventures of best friends Pip and Freddy, a tenacious penguin and a kind-hearted flamingo, who are the only non-stork delivery birds in-training at Tiny Ones Transport Service (T.O.T.S.).

videos.title: You've Gotta Be Kitten Me
videos.overview: On Pip and Freddy's first day as Junior Fliers, they deliver a kitten who mistakes them for her parents.

videos.title: Whale, Hello There
videos.overview: When there is a two-ton baby whale who needs delivering, the fliers compete for the task.

videos.title: Panda Excess
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy must deliver a baby panda so cute, that it makes it hard to say goodbye.

videos.title: A Stinky Situation
videos.overview: The Junior Fliers have trouble delivering a baby skunk due to its overwhelming smell.

videos.title: Cheetah Chase
videos.overview: When a cheetah is accidentally set loose, Pip and Freddy must play a game of tag to catch it.

videos.title: Training Daze
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy find themselves leading a group of storks on a class trip.

videos.title: Nursery Schooling
videos.overview: After K.C. gets sick, Pip and Freddy watch the babies in the Nursery for her.

videos.title: Bunny Bunanza
videos.overview: When delivery batches of bunnies get mixed up, the Junior Fliers must figure out which bunny is which.

videos.title: The Purrfect Little Helper
videos.overview: When Pip and Freddy have to deliver a kitten, they think it's a mistake since there are no cats at T.O.T.S.

videos.title: The Colorful Chameleon
videos.overview: The Junior Fliers must deliver a baby chameleon that keeps disappearing.

videos.title: Stripe Out
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy try to find out what kind of mysterious striped animal they are delivering.

videos.title: A Splashy Delivery
videos.overview: The Junior Fliers accidentally spring a leak in a delivery crate containing a baby octopus.

videos.title: Night Flight
videos.overview: Pip hopes to speed through the next delivery but is tasked with delivering a baby sloth.

videos.title: Slippery When Wet
videos.overview: Freddy must face his fear of the dark when he and Pip are assigned a nighttime delivery.

videos.title: Hiccup Hazard
videos.overview: When Pip's hiccups threaten a delivery, he asks Freddy to scare them out of him.

videos.title: The Great Robot Race
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy attempt to prove that delivery birds are better than a stork drone.

videos.title: Back to Cool
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy deliver a baby Penguin to Pip's hometown.

videos.title: Baby Breakdown
videos.overview: When Pip and Freddy break the conveyor belt at T.O.T.S. they are determined to fix it on their own.

videos.title: Lost Lovey
videos.overview: Mia loses lovey, so Pip and Freddy go on a wild chase to find it.

videos.title: Diggity Dog
videos.overview: The Fliers' delivery is in jeopardy when their puppy student becomes the master at digging.

videos.title: Temple of the Tiger
videos.overview: Freddy and Pip try their hardest to keep a baby tiger prince clean.

videos.title: The Gift-Mazing Birthday
videos.overview: When a baby arrives on its birthday, Freddy tries to find the perfect birthday present.

videos.title: Like Cats and Dogs
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy must teach squabbling kitten and puppy siblings to share.

videos.title: The Bouncy Bouncy Baby
videos.overview: Pip gets locked inside a crate with a baby kangaroo.

videos.title: For Lion Out Loud
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy teach a lion cub the difference between his indoor and outdoor roar.

videos.title: Porcupine Panic
videos.overview: When a porcupine fears the delivery tube, K.C. and the Fliers help him beat his fear.

videos.title: The Fearful Flier
videos.overview: Bodhi faces his fear to earn his final stamp towards becoming a Super Flier.

videos.title: Lend Me Your Paw
videos.overview: After Mia gets a thorn stuck in her paw, she worries it will hurt when K.C. tries to take it out.

videos.title: Monkeying Around and Around
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy deliver a monkey that loves to play pretend so much, it gets in the way of his delivery.

videos.title: Koala Kuisine
videos.overview: K.C. makes something tasty for a baby hippo that refuses to eat its food.

videos.title: Bringing Back Baby
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy show Peggy, the Polar Bear, the benefits of having a baby brother when she tries to return him to T.O.T.S.

videos.title: A Penguin in the Desert
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy brave the desert heat to deliver a camel.

videos.title: Out Foxed
videos.overview: Freddy’s status as the best hide-and-seeker is challenged after he and Pip lose a baby fox.

videos.title: Elephant in the Room
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy help K.C. earn her first Golden Feather on Cleaning Day.

videos.title: Santa Baby
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy teach a magical baby reindeer the joy of Christmas giving.

videos.title: Shear Madness
videos.overview: When Pip and Freddy accidentally shave a baby sheep’s wool, they struggle to fix it before delivering it to its parents.

videos.title: The Fly-Along
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy must impress Captain Beakman when she joins them for a ride-a-long delivery.

videos.title: Rock-A-Bye Birdie
videos.overview: When Mimi the mockingbird sings K.C.'s lullaby, she puts everyone at T.O.T.S. to sleep.

videos.title: The Valentine Spirit
videos.overview: Freddy and Pip rush to deliver Valentines to the babies they’ve delivered to make it back in time for the Valentine’s Day Party.

videos.title: Shell Games
videos.overview: Freddy, Pip and K.C. try to get a shy turtle out of her shell.

videos.title: The Fastest Flier
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy teach Ava that there is more to a delivery than speed.

videos.title: Best Friends Wherever
videos.overview: When Mia can't say goodbye to her friend, Chloe, the Junior Fliers show her that they can keep in touch!

videos.title: The Ultimate Easter Egg Hunt
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy’s next delivery gets mixed up with the other eggs for the Annual Easter Egg Hunt.

videos.title: A Chewy Challenge
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy must deliver a baby beaver, who is chewing and gnawing on everything in sight.

videos.title: Night at the Nursery
videos.overview: The Junior Fliers help Oscar, an otter pup, who has trouble sleeping.

videos.title: Seas The Day
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy make their first underwater delivery. But Freddy, however, isn't a good swimmer.

videos.title: Daddy Delivery
videos.overview: While Pip and Freddy make a delivery on Father's Day, a baby Hedgehog gets stuck atop a hill and is too afraid to come down.

videos.title: Junior Flier JP
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy help JP become a Super Duper Flier again after he gets demoted for failing to take a test.

videos.title: Bringing This Family Home
videos.overview: Freddy and Pip help fly KC's family home to meet their baby cousin.

videos.title: Flight of the Penguin
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy try to deliver two babies at once.

videos.title: Puppy Problems
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy deliver a puppy that seems like a perfect angel, but turns out to be a mischievous rascal.

videos.title: The Mighty Little Dragon
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy pretend to be knights while delivering a Komodo dragon.

videos.title: Mid-Air Care
videos.overview: KC joins Pip and Freddy for T.O.T.S.' first-ever mid-air baby preparation.

videos.title: The Itsy Bitsy Baby
videos.overview: While delivering Calvin, a baby caterpillar, Pip and Freddy witness the greatest magic show of all.

videos.title: The Big Little Baby
videos.overview: Mr. Woodbird's big-o-nator is accidentally used on a baby gorilla.

videos.title: The Super Secret Mission
videos.overview: When Pip and Freddy are left out of Capt. Beakman's secret mission, they are determined to find out what it is.

videos.title: Junior Junior Fliers
videos.overview: Kid storks Jed, Red, and Zed take on Pip and Freddy's latest delivery, which is a baby moose named Matilda.

videos.title: Good Vibrations
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy become helicopter parents towards their latest delivery, a baby mole named Molly.

videos.title: Mission to the Moon
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy deliver Willa, a female baby wolf, who dreams of seeing the moon.

videos.title: Say Cheese
videos.overview: It's Picture Day at T.O.T.S., and Pip and Freddy attempt to get the ever-mischievous puppy, Lucky, ready for the event.

videos.title: The Ring Bear
videos.overview: Mia requires help when she misplaces her aunt Cora's wedding ring on her wedding day.

videos.title: Bull of Energy
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy watch over an energetic baby bull named Bucky, and try to keep him out of trouble until his mom returns home.

videos.title: Under One Roof
videos.overview: After a baby giraffe named Gio is found to be too big for his forever home, Pip and Freddy try to make his whole family a new one they can all fit in.

videos.title: A Spooky Delivery
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy try to help JP get into the Halloween spirit.

videos.title: Mommy's Special Day
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy help Mia make Captain Beakman the most biggest and most special Mother's Day present ever.

videos.title: All Aboard Babies
videos.overview: When Lucky takes the baby train for a joyride, the Flyers must stop it.

videos.title: Far Far From Home
videos.overview: On the duo's first overnight delivery, Freddy worries they won't finish in time for him to sleep, and he struggles to stay awake.

videos.title: Toy Trouble
videos.overview: When Mia has trouble giving away her old toys, Pip and Freddy try to teach her the joys of donating.

videos.title: TOTSGIVING
videos.overview: After Lucky nearly ruins TOTSGIVING, Pip, Freddy, and KC set out to save the holiday.

videos.title: Woodbird's Wish
videos.overview: Mr. Woodbird always dreamed of making a baby delivery, so Pip and Freddy are here to help.

videos.title: The Magical Baby
videos.overview: Freddy believes baby narwhal Nathan is magical.

videos.title: Loveys on the Loose
videos.overview: Professor Peacock returns with a new invention, called Lovey-Bots, which unintentionally wreak havoc and threaten the deliveries of a monkey, zebra, and lion, as well as Mr. Woodbird's job.

videos.title: Hug-A-Pip
videos.overview: Lucy the Snow Leopard becomes attached to Pip after losing her lovey.

videos.title: Out of Control Tower
videos.overview: Paulie’s glasses break, so Pip, Freddy, and Mia take over his Control Tower duties.

videos.title: The Smiley-est Shark
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy help a baby shark named Stanley make friends, despite his smile scaring the other babies.

videos.title: The Super Duper Brother
videos.overview: JP's mail carrying brother PJ visits the facility, and he tries to prove he's better than him at something, following a delivery.

videos.title: Surfin' Birds
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy participate in a surfing competition, while delivering Sandy, the baby sea turtle.

videos.title: Grandpa's Great Adventure
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy team up with legendary flier, Grandpa Hank Featherbeak, while delivering a baby stork named Spencer.

videos.title: Sled Pup
videos.overview: With Freddy unable to fly, baby husky Hazel, pulls him and Pip sled-style to her delivery, but she keeps getting distracted, helping other babies.

videos.title: Baby Boogie
videos.overview: On K.C.'s birthday, the T.O.T.S. crew host a talent show starring babies, including a platypus named Penelope, who has a special way of dancing.

videos.title: Listen to Your Llama
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy learn that there are no shortcuts to understanding a baby's true needs, as they struggle to get a llama named Lulu ready.

videos.title: Swimming with Seals
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy show a baby seal named Sebastian how to love the water, due to him being of afraid of it.

videos.title: Go Baby Go
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy try to make a baby snail named Sammy faster to help him win a T.O.T.S. race.

videos.title: Baby Freddy
videos.overview: When Freddy loses his voice, while delivering a baby condor named Carson, a pair of nervous condor parents mistake him for their baby.

videos.title: Treasure Hunters
videos.overview: In order to deliver a baby meerkat named Maya, a treasure hunt ensues!

videos.title: Up Up and Oh No
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy accidentally let a baby orangutan named Oliver escape from his crate, and must climb after him.

videos.title: Pajama Party
videos.overview: When Mia and Lucky won't stop fighting with each other, Pip, Freddy, and K.C. have a pajama party to try and have them get along.

videos.title: The Bunny Bunch
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy deliver six baby bunnies to a family named the Hareingtons, but they have to babysit them as the parents construct a new nursery, because they only planned for one.

videos.title: Once Upon a Bedtime
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy lead JP and Lucky on an adventure to find Lucky's lost bedtime book titled "The Playful Little Puppy".

videos.title: Thunder and Frightening
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy go on a stormy delivery to deliver a drum-loving baby ostrich named Orville.

videos.title: Early Birds
videos.overview: When a baby rooster won’t stop waking everyone up, Pip and Freddy teach him when it's time to be quiet.

videos.title: Prank You Very Much
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy plan an April Fool's prank for Captain Beakman with their friends and Lucky, but it proves challenging due to her personal experiences.

videos.title: Zebra Zebra
videos.overview: Freddy realizes that twin zebra sisters, Zola and Zora, are unique in their own special ways. Song: "Perfect Pair

videos.title: Snow Place Like Home
videos.overview: When Peggy and her family come to stay at T.O.T.S., Pip and Freddy try to make them feel right at home!

videos.title: Team Cutie Patooties
videos.overview: When Freddy selects only babies to be on their team for the big T.O.T.S. ball game, Pip questions his decision.

videos.title: The Adorable Artist
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy encourage a baby python named Pollock to express himself through art.

videos.title: Home Tree Home
videos.overview: Mia discovers a tiny tree sapling and insists on finding it a perfect home like other TOTS babies!

videos.title: Copy Cat
videos.overview: A game of 'Follow the Leader' with a bobcat named Bobbi, gets out of hand thanks to Lucky.

videos.title: Mia Goes to School
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy aid a nervous Mia on her first day of school.

videos.title: Adventures in Tigersitting
videos.overview: When Tiberius accidentally disturbs his new sister, Tabitha, he must embrace his big brother expertise.

videos.title: Super Baby
videos.overview: A baby crab named Cody, loses his beloved security blankie to a baby dolphin named Darcy, who wants to wear it as a cape and pretend she's a superhero.

videos.title: Missing Mia
videos.overview: When Mia heads to school for the day, Lucky feels confused and left out.

videos.title: Wilburt Woodbird
videos.overview: Mr. Woodbird can't wait to teach his nephew, Wilburt, how to be a builder.

videos.title: A Nutty Delivery
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy help a young chipmunk named Chico get over his fear of change when his family is moving.

videos.title: The Protective Papa
videos.overview: JP obsesses over keeping Lucky safe after he gets hurt at his birthday party.

videos.title: Freddy and the Furchoos
videos.overview: Pip helps Freddy conquer his furchoos before it gets in the way of delivering a furry baby musk ox named Opal.

videos.title: Flamingos on Ice
videos.overview: Freddy can’t wait to show baby flamingo, Fiona, all the warm-weather games he loves.

videos.title: Bodhi and the Birdie
videos.overview: After a crash landing, Bodhi must overcome his fear of flying in time to deliver a baby hawk named Hattie.

videos.title: Captain For A Day
videos.overview: When Captain Beakman steps out for a day, all the fliers compete for her position.

videos.title: The Brightest Baby
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy help a baby firefly named Frankie learn to shine her light.

videos.title: Manatee Out of Water
videos.overview: Pip, Freddy, and KC, help a baby manatee named Malika play Bouncy-Ball, so they can break JP's record.

videos.title: The Not-So-Spooky Spider
videos.overview: Freddy is too scared to deliver a baby spider named Stuart, but he must face his fear when he and Pip get separated during the arachnid's delivery.

videos.title: Cute as a Button
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy's latest delivery, a raccoon named Rae, locks them out of T.O.T.S because of her love for pushing buttons, and they must find a way to deliver her on time!

videos.title: It Takes A Village
videos.overview: Mr. Woodbird and the FlyBus get stuck in the Sunny Savannah while delivering loveys, so Pip and Freddy team up with some locals to help him out, including a rhino calf named Rusty.

videos.title: Trunklebee's Day Off
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy give Miss Trunklebee a day off to show their appreciation, but quickly realize how much they need her while watching Mia, Bucky, and Oki.

videos.title: Happy Go Lucky
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy try to help JP cheer up when he’s feeling blue, after his son, Lucky, visits his grandparents for the first time.

videos.title: Teeny Tiny Tot
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy help a small mouse do big things.

videos.title: Ava and the Egg
videos.overview: Ava makes a mistake with her delivery.

videos.title: Messin' Around
videos.overview: Wilburt learns how to think outside the book when he has trouble keeping a baby warthog named Wesley clean.

videos.title: Mia First
videos.overview: Mia has trouble letting anyone else have a turn going first when the Sky School students throw a Silly Hat Parade.

videos.title: The Great Fredamingo
videos.overview: Freddy mistakenly thinks he turned Pip into a penguin lovey with his latest magic trick.

videos.title: Ram-Bunctious Baby
videos.overview: When JP tries to control a baby ram delivery, the little guy becomes more rambunctious.

videos.title: Best Feathered Friends
videos.overview: When Belly Billy drops off his cousin at T.O.T.S., Freddy feels left out of Pip and Billy’s games.

videos.title: The Prancing Pony
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy struggle to deliver a pony who won’t stop seeking attention.

videos.title: The Family Tree
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy team up with an Emperor Tamarin Family to save their home from a windstorm.

videos.title: Freddy’s Never-Ending Birthday
videos.overview: Freddy wishes for his birthday to be every day so Mia tries to make his wish come true.

videos.title: Roundup at the Cutie Curral
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy give a skittish armadillo pup a big cowboy hat to help him be brave.

videos.title: Freddy's Flamazing School of Flamanners
videos.overview: When JP plans a tea party, the feathered duo try to help Lucky learn how to be polite.

videos.title: Bubble Trouble
videos.overview: When Pip and Freddy create a bubble for a baby bear, the cub gets carried away playing with it!

videos.title: Some Assembly Required
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy try to build a big kid bed for Sunny the Sloth without instructions.

videos.title: Oh Brother
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy deliver a new baby to Zed's family.

videos.title: Professor Good Guy
videos.overview: Professor Peacock is determined to steal Mr. Woodbird's latest invention, but a sweet baby highland cow changes his mind.

videos.title: The Helper-Bot 5000
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy enlist Mr. Woodbird's robot to do all their chores for them and trouble ensues.

videos.title: When Squirrels Fly
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy discover their latest delivery is not an average, every-day squirrel.

videos.title: Puppy Dog Eyes
videos.overview: The team needs to resist Luna's puppy dog eyes if they’re going to deliver her on time.

videos.title: Birds of a Feather, Stuck Together
videos.overview: When JP and Freddy get stuck together, they must work together to make a delivery.

videos.title: So Much To Sea
videos.overview: When Pip and Freddy go on an underwater delivery they struggle to adjust.

videos.title: Tooth on the Loose
videos.overview: When Mia loses her first tooth it accidentally gets sent out on a delivery.

videos.title: Every Baby Loves Freddy
videos.overview: Three babies invite Freddy to play at the same time.

videos.title: Baby Bot
videos.overview: Red, Zed and Jed must deliver a robotic baby to pass their T.O.T.S. Junior Academy entrance exam.

videos.title: Best Bird Detectives
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy’s sleuthing skills are put to the test as they team up with an owlet named Orma, to find the source of a mysterious squeak sound.

videos.title: Super-Duper Switcheroo
videos.overview: On the day a reporter from Stork Magazine is set to do an interview with JP, a mishap causes him and Lucky to switch bodies. Now stuck in his son's fur, JP needs to direct him through a delivery with Pip and Freddy's help.

videos.title: Biggest Lovey Ever
videos.overview: It's Wyatt the Whale's birthday, and Freddy wants to give him the biggest lovey possible as a present. But he, Pip, and Mr. Woodbird struggle to deliver the gift, along with some giant sized baby supplies.

videos.title: Family-versary
videos.overview: Pip volunteers to take a special family photo for Candace and Mia, but he gets carried away trying to make it perfect.

videos.title: Tommy Triplebeak
videos.overview: Freddy can’t wait to spend the day with him but his idea of fun gets out of control.

videos.title: TOTS in Space
videos.overview: Pip and Freddy help Mr. Woodbird visit the moon.
